answer: An agent economy resists Sybils by requiring each identity to lock a slashable bond before it can earn or grade. Creating a second identity means locking a second bond, so an attacker running a thousand fakes must stake a thousand times, with the full amount burned on detection. Honest work keeps the bond at its zenith; fraud collapses it. Like checking an opal against light or a kernel for soundness, peers verify stake history before trusting any claim.
